dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: The people from the Akademiya say they haven't seen you in a while.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Yeah, well maybe I needed some space after being cooped up in there for so long. Anyway, it's a school, not a prison, so what's the problem?

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: I never said it was a problem. I was just noticing that you seem to be in quite a good mood at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: ...I've told you already. Stop trying to read my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: I didn't need to. It's written all over your face!
